reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: the licence is expressly non-exclusive in both directions (p0030, p0043, p0049) and the Licensor retains the right to license the technology to others, so no sole-supplier, requirements or exclusive-dealing covenant binds Customer.

No minimum-volume or 'all requirements' commitment is present, and the Article II restrictions are ordinary scope/IP limits on use of the Licensed Technology, not restraints on procuring competing FX platform services.

The Article XXII Right of First Refusal is correctly scoped out of this rule: it is triggered by a third-party offer to buy Licensee's assets or merge with Licensee (a change-of-control right), not a first refusal on future purchases or supply, and the finding properly flags it for the assignment/change-of-control rule instead.

Consistent with a compliant finding, the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment was proposed; the deterministic check ('no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains') passes.
